source_row.stem: During an unplanned electronic health record downtime, nursing staff should:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Follow the facility's downtime procedure, typically including paper-based documentation until the system is restored","B":"Relying on staff memory to later recreate the documentation once the system eventually comes back online","C":"Discharging most current clients from the unit right away as the facility's standard downtime response","D":"Pausing most client documentation until the electronic system has been fully restored"}}
source_row.rationale: Facilities maintain downtime procedures, typically including paper-based documentation methods, to ensure continuity of care and documentation during unplanned EHR outages, with later reconciliation into the electronic system.
